Lesson.signature: Lesson(title: string, objective?: string, children: Node[])
Lesson.description: The root of every response: a title, an optional one-sentence objective, and the lesson body as a free mix of this library's components (Col, Row, Grid, Card, Title, Text, Markdown, List, Math, Chart, Svg, Scene3D, Slider, SegmentedControl, Checkbox, Button, Quiz, ...). Compose the body the way a real page would be laid out, not as one long Markdown block.

Col.description: Vertical layout. Without gap it spaces blocks like an article.

Row.signature: Row(children: Node[], gap?: number, align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between", wrap?: boolean)
Row.description: Horizontal layout; items are vertically centered. Use wrap for chips and controls so a narrow panel never overflows.

Grid.signature: Grid(children: Node[], columns?: number, minChildWidth?: number, gap?: number)
Grid.description: Equal columns (default 2). With minChildWidth (px) the columns drop on a narrow panel.

Card.signature: Card(children: Node[], variant?: "outline" | "soft", padding?: number, gap?: number)
Card.description: Panel with a border; soft is a filled panel for summaries and callouts.

Divider.description: A thin horizontal rule between sections.

Spacer.description: Fills the free space in a Row.

Title.description: Heading. 2xl for the page title, lg for a section, md for a card title.

Text.signature: Text(text: string | Node[], size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", color?: Color, weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold", italic?: boolean, tabularNums?: boolean)
Text.description: Paragraph; supports **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](https://…) and inline math like $x_1$. text may be a list mixing strings and inline components: ["Slope ", Math("m = \\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}", true)].

Caption.description: Small secondary text, such as a figure caption or a unit note.

Badge.description: Small pill tag for a topic, a level or a class label.

Link.description: Opens an absolute http(s) URL in the browser.

ListItem.signature: ListItem(title: string, description?: string, marker?: string, children?: Node[])
ListItem.description: One list entry: a title, an optional description (Markdown and $math$ allowed) and optional extra blocks. marker replaces the bullet or number.

List.description: Bulleted or numbered list. number puts each step in a numbered circle; timeline joins the markers with a line.

Markdown.description: Prose with headings, lists, quotes, code, tables and math ($x^2$ inline, $$ on its own lines for display).

Quote.description: A callout or quotation with a side rule: a key idea, a warning, a definition. cite names the source.

Code.description: Code block with a copy button. Displays code only; nothing in it is executed.

Math.description: LaTeX formula typeset with KaTeX, e.g. Math("\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = \\frac{1}{3}"). Display style by default; inline true to sit inside a Text list. No dollar signs.

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "solid" | "outline" | "soft" | "ghost", size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", disabled?: boolean)
Button.description: Runs its action when pressed, such as @Set($epochs, $epochs + 100). Every Button needs an action.

Slider.signature: Slider(value: $binding<number>, min: number, max: number, step?: number, label?: string, unit?: string)
Slider.description: Slider bound to a $variable, e.g. Slider($c, 0.1, 100, 0.1, "C"). Shows label and value; everything computed from the variable updates live.

SegmentedControl.description: 2 to 4 short mutually exclusive choices in a row, bound to a $variable.

Checkbox.description: A labelled checkbox bound to a $variable, e.g. to show or hide a margin, a layer or a hint.

Quiz.signature: Quiz(question: string, options: string[], answerIndex: number, explanation: string)
Quiz.description: One multiple-choice check of understanding with instant feedback. answerIndex is the zero-based index of the correct option.

Svg.signature: Svg(children: Node[], viewBox: string, width?: Length, height?: Length)
Svg.description: A drawing for diagrams, geometry, free-body figures, graphs and mechanisms. Scales to its width; shape arguments accept expressions, so $variables can move them.

Circle.signature: Circle(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Ellipse.signature: Ellipse(cx: number, cy: number, rx: number, ry: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

Rect.signature: Rect(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number, rx?: number)

Line.signature: Line(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number, dashed?: boolean)

Path.signature: Path(d: string, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)
Path.description: d uses M L H V C S Q T A Z commands with numbers only.

Polyline.signature: Polyline(points: string, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, fill?: Color, opacity?: number)
Polyline.description: points like "0,0 10,5 20,0". Build a curve from data with @Join(@Each(xs, "x", x + "," + f), " ").

Polygon.signature: Polygon(points: string, fill?: Color, stroke?: Color, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number)

G.signature: G(children: Node[], transform?: string, opacity?: number)

SvgText.signature: SvgText(text: string, x: number, y: number, size?: number, fill?: Color, anchor?: "start" | "middle" | "end", weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold")
SvgText.description: A label inside an Svg. Plain text only.

Chart.signature: Chart(kind: "line" | "area" | "bar" | "scatter", data: any[], x: string, y: string[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
Chart.description: Chart of rows: data is a list of objects, x the key of the horizontal value, y the keys of one or more series. line, area and scatter need numeric x; bar treats x as category labels. Example: Chart("line", @Each(@Linspace(0, 6.3, 80), "t", {t: t, v: @Sin(t)}), "t", ["v"], "t (rad)", "sin t").

Scene3D.signature: Scene3D(points: {x: number, y: number, z: number, label?: number | string}[], plane?: {w: any, b: number}, azimuth?: number, elevation?: number, extent?: number, height?: number, axisLabels?: any)
Scene3D.description: Rotatable 3D scatter plot for spatial data. points is a list of {x, y, z, label?}; optional labels distinguish groups. azimuth and elevation (degrees) may be bound to sliders. extent sets the half-width of the axes; omit it to fit the data.

Sin.description: Sine of an angle in radians

Cos.description: Cosine of an angle in radians

Tan.description: Tangent of an angle in radians

Atan2.description: Angle in radians of the point (x, y) from the x axis

Ln.description: Natural logarithm; null for zero or a negative number

Sqrt.description: Square root; null for a negative number

FloorValue.description: Largest whole number not above number

Ceiling.description: Smallest whole number not below number

Clamp.signature: Clamp(number: number, min: number, max: number) → number
Clamp.description: number kept between min and max

Lerp.signature: Lerp(a: number, b: number, t: number) → number
Lerp.description: The value a fraction t of the way from a to b

Dot.description: Dot product of two number lists of equal length

Norm.description: Euclidean length of a number list

Range.signature: Range(start: number, end: number, step?: number) → number[]
Range.description: Numbers from start up to end (not included) by step (default 1), e.g. @Range(0, 3) is [0, 1, 2]

Linspace.signature: Linspace(start: number, end: number, count: number) → number[]
Linspace.description: count evenly spaced numbers from start to end, both included, e.g. @Linspace(0, 1, 5) is [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]

Append.description: Copy of the list with item added at the end

Toggle.description: Adds item if missing, removes it if present (a set of strings or numbers)

Includes.signature: Includes(list: any[] | string, item: any) → boolean
Includes.description: True if the list has item, or the text contains it

Take.description: The first n items; a negative n takes the last n

Fixed.description: number as text with exactly decimals digits (0 to 8), e.g. @Fixed(3.14159, 2) is "3.14"

Join.description: List items as one text, separated by separator (default ", ")
